title: Best practical Ds solver with theorem-backed certificate
statement: DS19 closes the deployment-facing question by reduction. For d_psi=1 the tilt-DP construction gives a valid generalized bracket p^+<=g^+<=d and a regular in-bin bracket p_reg<=g_reg<=d, with exact closure iff a concrete DP-optimal labeling satisfies the tilt normal equation. Strong duality is false by an exact order-one N=4 counterexample. Fixed-tilt exact DP evaluation and polynomial certified-epsilon dual minimization are available; exact general polynomial bit complexity is isolated as OPEN-DS-TILT-DUAL-EXACT-COMPLEXITY. On the exact DS18 law, the beta-zero interval DP is Delta-consistent almost surely and inherits the audited value-to-disagreement transfer, but not exchange stability, local-ascent selection, or compile authorization. For d_psi>1 the matrix-tilt outer map need not even be quasiconvex. The observable compile decision is therefore: an exhibited regular saddle certifies finite globality; an open bracket reports a bounded interval; projected efficient-score compilation remains the currently established unconditional projected route; a DS14 companion requires all audited sequence hypotheses; otherwise refuse.
assumptions: Tier A certificate: d_psi=1, d_lambda>=1, positive rational finite weights, exact-K nonempty cells, raw uncentered score rows
the generalized DS11 pseudo-inverse and ordinary DS9 in-bin comparison domains are reported separately
the exact DS18 Delta-consistency corollary uses only the named bounded law, K=3, beta=0, iid equal weights, and exact scores
no src or public compile surface is authorized before an independent audit of DS19
